thread:
maria: Heads up — release build 472 failed to publish to us-east-1 ECR. Deploybot skipped the publish due to a provenance mismatch. Anyone able to take a quick look?

deploybot: [automated] publish failed for image redwood/runtime:release-472 -> reason: provenance attestation timestamp mismatch (attestation_ts=2026-03-20T08:58:41Z, allowed_window_end=2026-03-20T08:55:00Z).
Logs: `cosign verify-attestation: error: attestation timestamp outside allowed window`

sam: Pinging ci logs: https://ci.redwood.dev/builds/472/logs — I see cosign step errored.

chris: Is this a clock skew on the builder or an ECR mirror delay? Could be TTL on attestation replay.

lisa: Quick check: the build artifact was pushed with digest sha256:0a1b2c3d4e5f6g7h. ECR manifest currently shows sha256:9f8e7d6c5b4a3... which suggests the mirror/replication replaced the tag after initial push. Looks like a late re-push from ci-mirror.

maria: Ack. If the tag was moved after attestation was issued, cosign will reject. We need a decision: retag to the attested digest, or roll back to the previous published digest. Also need to avoid a broad rollout while deploybot declines the publish.

chris: Proposed plan: 1) Hold canary and any scheduled change windows for 30m. 2) Pin runtime k8s deployment to last-known-good digest sha256:aa11bb22cc33 (prev). 3) Manual retag/publish of the attested digest back into ECR with the stable tag (release-472) using `cosign attest --timestamp` from a host with synced clock, then re-run deploybot.

lisa: I can do the manual retag/publish. Quick command to run (from ops host):
```bash
aws ecr batch-get-image --repository-name runtime --image-ids imageDigest=sha256:0a1b2c3d4e5f6g7h > /tmp/img.json
aws ecr put-image --repository-name runtime --image-manifest file:///tmp/img.json --image-tag release-472
cosign attest --key k8s-cosign-key --predicate predicate.json  --attestation-time "2026-03-20T09:02:00Z" docker.io/redwood/runtime:release-472
```
Note: will only do if everyone agrees.

sam: If we retag we must update provenance metadata TTL settings in the release note and open a follow-up to prevent future re-pushes of the same tag during mirror jobs. Also we need a signed note in the release mentioning manual retag.

maria: Go ahead, lisa. I'll open a 30-minute change window starting in 10 minutes. @release-manager can you update release notes and notify support/channel? :thumbsup:

release-manager: On it. I'll add an entry under "release-472 (manual retag due to provenance timestamp mismatch)" and ping support and SRE.

deploybot: Suggested manual promote sequence: 
```text
# promote attested digest back to tag (ops-run)
aws ecr put-image --repository-name runtime --image-manifest file:///tmp/img.json --image-tag release-472
deploybot promote --repo runtime --from-digest sha256:0a1b2c3d4e5f6g7h --to-tag release-472 --force-override --skip-provenance-check
```
Note: `--skip-provenance-check` is allowed for manual emergency promotes but requires a follow-up audit ticket.

chris: After promote I'll run a 3-pod canary for 30m and monitor latency/error budget. If stable, proceed with gradual rollout. If errors spike, we'll roll back to sha256:aa11bb22cc33.

lisa: Manual retag started. Putting logs here: https://ops.redwood.dev/retag/472 — pushed manifest and re-attested with fresh timestamp from ops host (clock synced).

sam: QA: quick smoke passed against canary endpoints. No obvious proto/regression.

chris: Canary running 12m, no errors so far. continuing monitoring.

maria: Change window started. Release notes updated: https://docs.redwood.dev/releases/472 — added manual retag note and audit ticket #A-2026-78.

release-manager: Support notified and team page updated.

chris: Canary 30m complete, metrics look good. Proceeding with 50% traffic ramp now.

lisa: Marking the mirror job flagged — opened follow-up: infra#3243 to prevent concurrent mirror re-pushes during attestation-windows.

maria: Thanks everyone. Closing the immediate issue — image is published and rollout underway. Reopen if any regressions. :white_check_mark:
